Percy Warner Night Ride

Nashville, TN · Mountain bike

Beginner friendly

Percy Warner Night Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Nashville, TN. It rolls every Thursday at 7:00 pm from Percy Warner Park main mountain bike trailhead, next to the clubhouse. Pace: all skill levels.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all skill levels.
Check
Look at @trailfitnessbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Percy Warner Night Ride group ride

A weekly mountain bike night ride at Percy Warner Park. All skill levels are welcome and it lasts about an hour. Bring lights. The ride is cancelled if the trail is closed.
